sentences.text:
Sunil Sardar @ Pagla vs Unknown on 15 March, 2024
 15.03.2024.

23.
 Ct.No.28.
 as  (Allowed)
 C.R.M. (DB) 604 of 2024  In Re:- An application for bail under Section 439 of th  of Criminal Procedure in connection with Murutia P.S. C  No.184 of 2021 dated 30.08.2021 under Sections  354B/376/511 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 8 of   POCSO Act.

In the matter of : Sunil Sardar @ Pagla.
 .... Petitio  Mr. Soumyajit Das Mahapatra,
 Mr. Amanul Islam,
 Mr. Sourav Mukherjee.
 ...for the Peti  Mr. Ranabir Roy Chowdhury,
 Mr. Anindya Sundar Chatterjee.

...for the   1.
Petitioner is in custody for one year and six months.
2. Learned Advocate for the State opposes the bail prayer.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
Vulnerable witness i.e. victim has already been examined.
Petitioner is in custody for a considerable period of time.
There is no chance of abscondence.
4. Under such circumstances, we are inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

5. Accordingly, the petitioner viz., Sunil Sardar @ Pagla shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Judge, Special Court under the POCSO Act, Tehatta, Nadia subject to condition that Signed By : ALOK SETH High Court of Calcutta 18 th of March 2024 01:39:55 PM he shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.
